title: Warehouse query tuning decision
purpose: Evidence-led decision across scan volume, SQL and table optimization, concurrency management, cache reuse, and representative validation.
accessibleSummary: Warehouse query tuning decision. Query workload; Data scanned is excessive?; Optimize layout and SQL; Concurrency contention?; Repeated result pattern?; Measure, then revisit.
longDescription: Evidence-led decision across scan volume, SQL and table optimization, concurrency management, cache reuse, and representative validation.

nodes.label: Query workload
nodes.summary: A warehouse request arrives with SQL shape, concurrency, and freshness needs.
nodes.detail: Profile the workload before assuming one optimization fits.

evidence.note: Fabric Warehouse provides managed T-SQL analytics over OneLake.

drill.example: A dashboard aggregate runs beside ELT.

nodes.label: Data scanned is excessive?
nodes.summary: Poor filtering or layout can make a query read more than its result requires.
nodes.detail: Inspect pruning, predicates, statistics and organization before scaling.

drill.example: A date filter scans years of rows.
failureModes: Adding capacity while retaining avoidable scans.

nodes.label: Optimize layout and SQL
nodes.summary: Selective queries, suitable types, statistics, and table organization are core tuning levers.
nodes.detail: Align physical data and predicates so irrelevant work is eliminated.

evidence.note: Guidance covers query design, data types, statistics, and table organization.

drill.example: Replace a non-sargable date expression with a bounded predicate.

nodes.label: Concurrency contention?
nodes.summary: Workload management can control competing warehouse requests.
nodes.detail: Check whether a healthy query is delayed only with other workloads.

evidence.note: Warehouse workload management controls competing workloads.

drill.example: BI receives predictable treatment during a bulk load.

nodes.label: Repeated result pattern?
nodes.summary: Caching can avoid repeating eligible warehouse work.
nodes.detail: Confirm freshness and query shape permit reuse.

evidence.note: Fabric Warehouse uses caching in query performance behavior.

drill.example: A repeated dashboard query reuses eligible data.
failureModes: Assuming similar queries always hit cache.

nodes.label: Measure, then revisit
nodes.summary: Verify each change under representative data and concurrency.
nodes.detail: Compare plan, scan, duration and queueing instead of anecdotal speed.

evidence.note: Warehouse tuning depends on observed workload behavior, not one universal setting.
